spritelab/fAlPieds.phrase: All your characters put their feet at the same height, as if standing on the same ground.

spritelab/fDetect.phrase: The tool counts the pictures on your sheet by itself and draws a box around each one.

spritelab/pflip.phrase: Your character turns around and looks the other way, like in a mirror.

spritelab/pixelOn.phrase: Your drawing becomes big squares and only a few colours, like in an old video game.

spritelab/poDx.phrase: A shadow appears behind your character, slightly offset, as if a lamp were lighting it.

spritelab/poWidth.phrase: A line surrounds your character so it shows up on any background.

tilelab/formeKind.phrase: Your tile changes shape: a diamond for a game seen at an angle, or a six-sided hexagon.

tilelab/jeuApercuBtn.phrase: A new map draws itself at random with your tiles, to see if they go well together.

tilelab/jeuKind.phrase: You choose how many pieces to make: many for nicely rounded corners, or sixteen to go fast.

tilelab/method.phrase: Mirror folds your texture like a sheet folded in four: the edges always meet perfectly.

tilelab/runBtn.phrase: Your texture joins up: laid side by side many times, you can no longer see where each piece ends.

tilelab/tlGrilleType.phrase: Your cells become diamonds, staggered like the paving of a game seen at an angle.

photolab/pl-aj-blackWhite.phrase: One click adds a layer that removes the colours: your picture turns grey, and you can remove it whenever you like.

photolab/pl-espace.phrase: Pick a workspace in the list: panels and tools rearrange for what you want to do.

photolab/pl-outil-brush.phrase: Drag across the picture: a stroke of your colour is painted wherever you go.

photolab/pl-outil-cloneStamp.phrase: Alt-click what you want to copy, then paint elsewhere: the same piece of picture reappears under your brush.

photolab/pl-outil-crop.phrase: Draw a frame on the picture then press Enter: everything outside the frame disappears.

photolab/pl-outil-magicWand.phrase: Click a colour: the whole patch of that colour is selected at once.

photolab/pl-outil-rectMarquee.phrase: Drag across the picture: a dotted rectangle surrounds the part you are going to change.
